preconditions.description: The total number of nodes n must be between 3 and 200,000.
The number of exit-nodes k must be between 2 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the minimum possible distance between the two most distant exit-nodes.
The output must contain exactly n lines, including the distance and n-1 wire connections.

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(x) in range(1, n + 1) for x in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each wire connection must connect two valid node ids between 1 and n.
